_comment: Per-category firmware annotations. Independent of all_effects.json (which is the raw RE capture, captured against GX-10 firmware 1.00 where all categories are present). The keys here are category names (matching the `name` field in all_effects.json); the values record when that category became available on each device family member. Hosts that ship a unified GX-10/GX-100 dictionary use this to filter the visible effect list at runtime based on the connected device's Identity-Reply software-version. Sources / confidence notes are in docs/firmware_versions.md.

SLICER.confidence: high — name matches press release exactly

SITAR_SIM.confidence: high — name matches press release exactly

HMN.confidence: high — HMN is the GX series' standard short name for Humanizer (vocal-vowel formant)

categories_unverified._comment: Category names that *might* be among the v2.0 additions but the press wording is ambiguous — left untagged until confirmed.
categories_unverified.T_WAH: Press release says "Auto Wah" was added in v2.0. T_WAH is BOSS's standard "Touch Wah" category (envelope-following wah), which is the same effect class. But Touch Wah may have been in the GX-100 v1.x already and v2.0 only added a new TYPE within it (not the whole category). Verify against a v1.x GX-100 and re-tag at sub-type granularity once the schema supports it.
categories_unverified.T_WAH_BASS: Same caveat as T_WAH; the bass companion is similarly ambiguous.

subtype_additions_pending_schema._comment: Effects/amps that v2.0 added as new TYPES within an existing category. Tagging these requires a per-type firmware annotation (per_effect_types.json + raw_payloads_hex), which the current schema doesn't support. Captured here so we don't lose the information — schema upgrade is a follow-up.
subtype_additions_pending_schema.OVERDRIVE.SD-1: v2.0 — Boss SD-1 Super Overdrive model added
subtype_additions_pending_schema.DISTORTION.DS-1: v2.0 — Boss DS-1 Distortion model added
amp_models_v2: (6 bass amps — exact names TBD; press referenced "vintage classics + modern favorites")
subtype_additions_pending_schema._provenance: Names from BOSS GX-100 v2.0 announcement / Guitar Player + Guitar World coverage 2024-09; cross-reference docs/firmware_versions.md.
